lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like formation of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 3-4 primary centroids vertically aligned between the lateral ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, intersecting with horizontal rows to form a series of rectangular anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-intensity, small-diameter high-luminance blobs. At least one distinct spot is visible near the posterior-central region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of small, high-frequency white spots on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, and a high-density field of micro-spots across the anterior cranial region.
